title: Invoice Line Disputes and Billing Error Credits on the Bluegate Business Storage Account
content:
A line on a Bluegate Business Storage Account invoice may be disputed within the program's dispute window, counted in days of the invoice date. A line shown to be wrong by the records, such as a delivery fee inside the monthly allowance or a duplicated service charge, is credited in full as a billing error correction. A line already credited is not credited again.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the window for disputing a line?**
The program's dispute window in days, counted from the invoice date of the invoice the line is on. *Hypothetical:* with a 30-day window, a line on an invoice dated 1 May may be disputed on 20 May, which is within 30 days of the invoice date.

**What makes a line wrong?**
The records must show it to be wrong. Two examples the rule names: a delivery fee charged for a parcel that was inside the monthly allowance, and a service charge that duplicates another charge for the same service.

**How much is credited?**
The line is credited in full, that is its whole amount, and the credit is recorded as a billing error correction against that line. A credit reduces the account balance.

**Can a line be credited twice?**
No. A line already credited is not credited again; the credits already recorded against that invoice line decide.

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

| Case | Shown wrong by the records | Already credited | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| A $2.50 extra-delivery charge for the 12th parcel of a month on a program with a 20-parcel allowance | Yes — the parcel was inside the allowance | No | Credited in full, $2.50, as a billing error correction |
| The same conference room charge of $24.00 appears twice for the same use | Yes — the second line duplicates the first | No | The duplicate line is credited in full, $24.00 |
| The duplicate $24.00 line above, raised again after its credit | Yes | Yes | Not credited again |
